from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalance(BaseModel):
    """Beginning balance of Cash and Cash Equivalents from one company's financial filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as reported")
    balance_amount: float | None = Field(description="Numerical balance value as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of reported amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for the beginning balance (e.g., 'December 31, 2023' or 'beginning of period')")
    cash_line_label: str | None = Field(description="Exact line-item label used in the financial statements")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt showing the cash balance figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CashBalance]
